PorchLyte vs VEXI: Which Is Better for Realtors in 2026?
PorchLyte and VEXI, side by side: what each one does and what it costs, from each company's own pages.
Compare PorchLyte vs VEXI side-by-side. See pricing, features, and why 1,000+ realtors choose VEXI for done-for-you social media.

PorchLyte gives real estate agents AI tools and a monthly content library for their own marketing [1]. VEXI makes posts, videos, designs and captions from what you ask for. The two overlap on social media and work in different ways.

PorchLyte is a set of AI tools for real estate agents, built by Tracy Henning, an agent with 32+ years in the business who still sells homes [1]. You give its tools a photo, listing details, comps or a client situation, and they help you create captions, email sequences, seller reports and listing presentations [1]. The membership also includes a monthly content calendar with captions written, Canva templates ready to brand, reel scripts and hooks, lead campaigns, and live calls and training [1]. Its home page lists one plan at $97 a month, or $970 a year, with no contracts [1].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on social media and work in different ways. Here is what each one does.
